correctness.rationale: The independent-thinning PGF and its second log derivative give the stated second factorial cumulant K. A two-region entire-growth argument yields a uniform coefficient envelope in L² of product Poisson, permitting dominated convergence of r log r. Tensor Poisson-Charlier orthogonality gives the exact Frobenius coefficient, while the exact KL product decomposition removes all diagonal terms. The witness has K off-diagonal equal to 1, exact finite-n covariance 1/n, and vanishing second marginal factorial cumulant, so its marginal KL is O(n^-4). The bundled executable independently checks exact moments and finite joint distributions; no infinite assertion relies on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The theorem computes a natural sharp information invariant in multitype rare-event sampling, separates marginal approximation errors from genuine dependence, and gives a covariance-only classification at the leading order for arbitrary higher-order input dependence. The explicit two-type law is exactly equidispersed in each marginal and has marginal KL of order at most n^-4, yet retains mutual information of order n^-2 with coefficient 1/2. The precise constant is motivated by information loss and model diagnostics rather than a gratuitous numerical slice; it does not claim a larger downstream theorem.
